APPROVE
The extraction moves the three loops verbatim and keeps their order and conditions, which removes about 21 nested-complexity points and leaves `InScript` around 5, so behaviour is unchanged; I couldn't open the source, though, so the build passing assumes the new parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match the locals and the signatures of `Known`, `ReadsGuard` and `ScriptGuarded`, which a CI build should confirm before merging.
